ground_truth_query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE status = 'active' AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE status IS NULL);
buggy_llm_query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE status = 'active');
explanation: A NULL in the subquery poisoned the NOT IN operator, returning 0 rows.
COUNT(column) silently ignores rows where the column is NULL, undercounting total records.
